Remake Image 1 completely as a seamless wallpaper albedo texture for the Office environment, using Image 2 (Office concept-art asset board) as the primary art direction. Replace ALL chevrons with a vintage understated vertical print: thin alternating pale vertical pinstripes with small faded elongated diamond/leaf lozenges in staggered rows. Calm pale neutral ivory/cream base (approximately RGB 232,224,206), restrained grey-beige print (approximately 212,201,180), fine fibrous paper tooth and sparse soft abrasion, no yellow lighting cast because the game adds yellow tint. Create the stained/damaged variant of this exact Office wallpaper texture.
